sections.heading: Traction Outsourcing International Corporate Retreat, Kigali 2026
paragraphs: Date: November 22nd - 30th, 2026 | Location: Kigali, Rwanda

sections.heading: Prepare Your Business for 2027
paragraphs: The Traction Outsourcing International Corporate Retreat is a premier yearly gathering crafted explicitly for CEOs, senior management executives, and ambitious entrepreneurs who take building institutional business structures seriously. This executive summit combines a leadership conference, business masterclass, and cross-border networking event into one immersive 9-day programme in Kigali, Rwanda. It is designed to step completely out of routine operational environments, bringing visionary leaders into close contact with billionaire mentors while exploring Africa's fastest-growing business hub.

Over the course of this highly immersive 2026 business event, you will participate in fireside chat sessions and masterclasses built to establish structural clarity, optimize workforce management strategies, and secure cross-border insights to solidify your enterprise layout ahead of the 2027 financial year. Registration for the T-ICR 2026 is open to business leaders from Nigeria and across Africa. Tickets are available until the event sells out.

sections.heading: Local Attendance Tier for Rwandan Executives & Businesses
sections.sub: The T-ICR 2026 is not exclusively for Nigerian visitors. If you are a Kigali-based executive, entrepreneur, or business leader, there is a local attendance tier designed for you.
paragraphs: Why Rwandan Executives Should Attend

The T-ICR 2026 brings CEOs, senior managers, and entrepreneurs from across Nigeria into Kigali for a dedicated week of strategy, mentorship, and business exchange. For Kigali-based leaders, this is a rare direct access point to a high-value cohort of West African business decision-makers, without travelling to Lagos or Abuja.

The local tier is built for Rwandan executives and business owners who want to network, pitch, explore trade partnerships, or simply sit in the same room with Nigerian enterprise leaders making expansion decisions about East Africa.

sections.heading: Important Information
paragraphs: Everything you need to know before attending the T-ICR 2026.
Dates
Retreat Dates: November 22nd - 30th, 2026, Kigali, Rwanda.
Registration Closes: November 1st, 2026, or as soon as the event sells out, whichever comes first.
Dress Code
Retreat Sessions: Corporate Casual.
Social Networking Night: Nigerian Casual.
Transfers and Cancellations

If you can no longer attend, your slot may be transferred to a colleague at no extra cost. Please notify our team in writing (email or WhatsApp) with the substitute delegate's details as early as possible.
For cancellation requests, please contact us directly on WhatsApp or partner@tolnigeria.com to discuss your options.
Travel Documentation

All delegates are responsible for holding a valid international passport and, where applicable, any visa required to enter Rwanda. Traction Outsourcing Limited will provide guidance and support during the process, but the delegate remains responsible for meeting Rwandan entry requirements ahead of the retreat dates.
Data Protection

Personal information collected during registration is processed and stored in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. Information provided by delegates is used solely for retreat administration, accreditation, communication, and operational purposes, and will not be sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes without prior consent.
Force Majeure

Traction Outsourcing Limited shall not be liable for any delay, cancellation, modification, interruption, or failure to perform its obligations resulting from circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, public health emergencies, government restrictions, civil unrest, acts of war, or transportation and infrastructure failures. In such circumstances, participants will be notified as soon as practicable and alternative arrangements made where possible.
For any other enquiries about the retreat, reach out to us on WhatsApp or at partner@tolnigeria.com.

sections.heading: Fireside Chat & Executive Mentorship Sessions
paragraphs: The T-ICR 2026 includes a 5-day intensive fireside chat and business leadership masterclass with five of Africa's most accomplished business minds. These are not panel discussions. They are direct, room-based conversations where you can ask questions, present challenges, and get answers grounded in real business experience at scale.

Topics covered across the fireside sessions include business structuring, workforce strategy, cross-border expansion, investment readiness, and executive leadership. The 2026 panel features Dr. Stephen Akintayo, Eizu Uwaoma, Adeyinka Igbinoba, Oluwatosin Olaseinde, William Adelewa ESQ, and Prince Elijah Abumoye as host. Register now to secure your seat at this 2026 leadership conference.

entries.q: Does Traction Outsourcing plan corporate retreats in Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing Limited plans and manages corporate retreats for businesses across Nigeria, including team-building retreats, leadership retreats, and annual strategy offsite events. We handle venue, programming, facilitation, logistics, and accommodation depending on the scope of the engagement.

entries.q: Can Traction Outsourcing organise a corporate retreat outside Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. Our international retreat capability includes the T-ICR, the Traction Outsourcing International Corporate Retreat, which we host annually in an African destination city. We also arrange bespoke international retreats for corporate clients on request. The 2026 edition takes place in Kigali, Rwanda in November.

entries.q: What is included in a Traction Outsourcing corporate retreat package?
entries.a: Packages vary by scope, but typically include venue selection and booking, programme design, facilitation and speaker coordination, accommodation arrangements, ground logistics, and post-retreat documentation. We build the package around what the client wants to achieve, not a fixed template.

entries.q: How far in advance should we book a corporate retreat?
entries.a: For domestic retreats, a minimum of four to six weeks allows us to source the right venue and build the programme properly. For international retreats, three months is advisable, particularly for group travel and accommodation. The earlier you engage us, the more options we can offer.

The T-ICR 2026, Traction Outsourcing International Corporate Retreat 2026, is an executive retreat and business conference taking place in Kigali, Rwanda from November 22 to 30, 2026. It brings together Nigerian and African business leaders for structured programming, speaker sessions, business matchmaking, and an immersive experience in one of Africa's most dynamic business cities.

The T-ICR 2026 is designed for CEOs, founders, senior executives, and business owners who want to combine high-quality business learning and networking with an international experience. Seats are allocated on a first-come basis and close once the event is full.

entries.q: What does the T-ICR 2026 registration fee cover?
entries.a: The registration fee is NGN 3,550,000 or USD 2,600 at the Early Bird rate, limited to the first 30 registrations and ending August 31st, 2026, or NGN 5,000,000 / USD 3,665 at the Standard rate afterward. Registration closes November 1st, 2026. It covers accommodation for the full retreat period, return flights (Abuja/Lagos to Kigali and back), programme fees, speaker sessions, business matchmaking, group activities, feeding, and ground logistics in Kigali. Full details are available on request.

entries.q: How do I register for the T-ICR 2026?
entries.a: Registration closes November 1, 2026. To secure your place, reach out via WhatsApp on 0704 708 2697 or email partner@tolnigeria.com. Seats are allocated on a first-come basis and close once the event is full.
